text:
jordan: Thinking about a retro/pixel-art + arcade night this Friday? I can bring my mini MAME cabinet and a stash of quarters :joystick: pizza and vibes. Who's in?

maya: heck yes. i’ll bring a 2-player SNES adapter and some extra controllers. what time?

sam: Fridays good for me after 6. can we do a high-score challenge? maybe 5-game gauntlet.

cleo: love this. can also bring my handhelds for a quick handheld speedrun bracket. also, i made a tiny pixel-art zine if anyone wants a copy :)

jordan: plan: arrive 6:30, warm-up casual play, start gauntlet at 7:15. prizes = leftover conference swag + cleo's zine.

alex: i have an HDMI adapter (USB-C -> HDMI). if anyone has old VGA-only monitors we should bring an adapter chain: `DVI->VGA` + `VGA->HDMI` is messy but works lol

maya: @alex can you label it so we don’t have to do the spaghetti again. also need a power strip and surge protector.

sam: signing up for the gauntlet: Super Mario Bros., Streets of Rage, Pac-Man, Metroid, Tetris. someone else pick the last one.

cleo: put me down for Rocket League (local) and a pocket Tetris showdown.

jordan: added a quick poll in the event: https://calendar.example.com/event/arcade-night — vote for prize type (:gift: swag / :pizza: pizza voucher / :trophy: trophy)

calendar-bot: Event created by jordan: "Retro Arcade + Pixel Potluck" Fri 6:30pm - 10:30pm (Office Kitchen). RSVP link: https://calendar.example.com/event/arcade-night

maya: trophy pls. but also pizza. compromises welcome :chef_hat:

alex: i can bring a small bluetooth speaker, but will mute during rounds if people want quiet for concentration.

sam: should we do a seed stage for indie jam devs? maybe set aside a table for folks to show quick prototypes.

jordan: love that. cleo you in for exhibitor table?

cleo: yes — i can host the pixel zine + prototype table. also bringing colored markers for impromptu pixel edits.

maya: final q: anyone allergic to pineapple on pizza? (important logistics)

alex: team pineapple is in the minority, bring both options.

jordan: perfect. i’ll post a signup sheet in #random with who’s bringing what. see y’all friday :video_game:
